name: perssua
description: Manage Perssua assistants and start desktop sessions from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Perssua desktop app on this machine. Claude can check the app, list and read your assistants, request reviewed updates or deletions, inspect operation results, start a session with an assistant + context + text files, create a brand-new custom assistant from a guided interview, and build clickable session links. Requires a compatible Perssua app (https://perssua.com) installed and opened at least once.

tools.name: app_status
tools.description: Check whether the Perssua app is installed and running.

tools.name: list_assistants
tools.description: List the user's configured Perssua assistants.

tools.name: get_assistant
tools.description: Request the complete editable definition of one Perssua assistant from the running app.

tools.name: update_assistant
tools.description: Request a revision-checked update to an existing Perssua assistant.

tools.name: delete_assistant
tools.description: Request a revision-checked, user-confirmed deletion of a custom Perssua assistant.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Read the app-authored status and result for an assistant operation.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Launch Perssua with an assistant, context, files, and an initial prompt.

tools.name: create_assistant
tools.description: Create a new custom Perssua assistant with a legacy-compatible name/instructions projection, optional native prompts, permanent knowledge, and a separate first-session context.

tools.name: create_session_link
tools.description: Build a clickable perssua:// session link.

prompts.name: new_assistant
prompts.description: Guided interview that designs a new Perssua assistant and creates it.
prompts.text: Interview me about the assistant I need (goal, style, native prompts, permanent knowledge, first-session context, kickoff), then call create_assistant.
